# LullCam

> LullCam turns an iPhone or iPad into a private baby monitor: live video and sound, cry alerts, no accounts, no cloud and no recordings. Made in Spain by Rodrigo Dávila. Available in English, Español, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Português (Portugal), Português (Brasil), 日本語, 한국어, 简体中文.

- Live video and sound: Several cameras at once, zoom and low-light image enhancement.
- Cry alerts: Also noise, movement, a covered or moved camera, battery and connection, even with your screen locked.
- Keep using your iPhone: Picture in Picture and background audio.
- Talk and lullabies: Talk to your baby, play lullabies and white noise with a timer.
- Night light: The camera's screen doubles as a soft light in the room.
- For the whole family: Your partner and guests use it for free.
- At home, all local: On the same Wi‑Fi, video goes straight from one device to another and never leaves your home.
- Away, encrypted: Over the internet it's end-to-end encrypted. The server can't see it and doesn't store it.
- No data: No accounts, analytics, ads or tracking. “Data Not Collected” on the App Store.

## Pricing

Free to download and join a family. LullCam Pro (needed to create a family): €19.99/year with a 3-day free trial, or €49.99 lifetime (prices vary by country). Partner and guests use it free. Apple Family Sharing supported.

## FAQ

### Does LullCam record or store video of my baby?
No. LullCam never records or stores video, audio or photos. Everything is live and nothing is written to disk.

### Do I need an account?
No. LullCam has no accounts. Your family's devices pair by scanning a QR code in person.

### Does it work away from home?
Yes, if you allow it. Over the internet, video and audio are end-to-end encrypted; the connection server can't see them and doesn't store them. On the same Wi‑Fi everything stays local.

### What do I need?
Two Apple devices: an old iPhone or iPad acts as the camera in the nursery and your iPhone is the parent screen. No camera to buy.

### How much does it cost?
Downloading to join a family is free. To create your family you need LullCam Pro: €19.99 per year with 3 days free, or €49.99 lifetime. Your partner and guests use it for free.

### Will it alert me if my baby cries while my phone is locked?
Yes. LullCam alerts you about crying, noise, movement, a covered or moved camera, battery and lost connection, even with the screen locked.

### Is it a medical device?
No. LullCam is not a medical device and does not replace adult supervision.
